name: Notion
label: Notion API 2026-03-11
description: Notion API 2026-03-11 via OfficialApiNode. Base https://api.notion.com/v1. Docs: https://developers.notion.com/reference/patch-page. Sends Notion-Version: 2026-03-11. Pages must be shared with the integration. Use in_trash not archived. page_update/database_page_update take properties plus icon and cover. OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data}. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Notion official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"page_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official Notion call to run. EXACT: page_create | page_archive | page_get | page_update | page_search | database_get | database_page_create | database_page_get | database_page_list | database_page_update | block_append | block_list | block_get | user_get | user_list | data_source_get | data_source_search | listen. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: page_update.

schema.label: parent
schema.description: Parent for page_create / database_page_create. Official: {"page_id":"..."} | {"database_id":"..."} | {"data_source_id":"..."}. Example: {"data_source_id":"21d2e8c9-54d4-80e5-bb5f-c0d7d4b3c4e1"}.

schema.label: properties
schema.description: Page properties map keyed by property name or id (official PATCH/POST /pages). Values follow the property type (title, rich_text, select, date, …). Used by page_create, page_update, database_page_create, database_page_update. Example: {"Name":{"title":[{"text":{"content":"Launch"}}]}}.

schema.label: icon
schema.description: Page icon for page_create/update and database_page_create/update. Official: {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🚀"} or {"type":"external","external":{"url":"https://..."}}.

schema.label: cover
schema.description: Page cover for page_create/update and database_page_create/update. Official: {"type":"external","external":{"url":"https://..."}}.

schema.label: children
schema.description: Block objects to create (page_create) or append (block_append). Official block list. Example: [{"object":"block","type":"paragraph","paragraph":{"rich_text":[{"text":{"content":"Hi"}}]}}].

schema.label: page_id
schema.description: Notion page id (dashed UUID) for page_get/update/archive and database_page_*. Example: 59833787-2cf9-4fdf-8782-e53db20768a5.

schema.label: in_trash
schema.description: Trash or restore a page (page_archive, page_update, database_page_update). Official 2026-03-11 field; do not send archived. Example: true.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Search text for page_search and data_source_search. Example: launch plan.

schema.label: filter
schema.description: Filter object for page_search ({"value":"page","property":"object"}), data_source_search, or database_page_list (property filter). Example: {"property":"Status","select":{"equals":"Done"}}.

schema.label: sort
schema.description: Single sort for page_search. Official: {"direction":"ascending","timestamp":"last_edited_time"}.

schema.label: database_id
schema.description: Database id for database_get. Example: 668d7974-90ed-4996-8e42-c3aa47dc27b0.

schema.label: data_source_id
schema.description: Data source id for database_page_list and data_source_get (Notion 2026-03-11). Example: 21d2e8c9-54d4-80e5-bb5f-c0d7d4b3c4e1.

schema.label: sorts
schema.description: Sorts array for database_page_list. Example: [{"property":"Name","direction":"ascending"}].

schema.label: start_cursor
schema.description: Pagination cursor from a previous list/query (block_list, user_list, database_page_list).

schema.label: block_id
schema.description: Block id for block_get, block_list, block_append. Example: 1a2b3c4d-....

schema.label: position
schema.description: block_append insert position. Official: {"type":"end"} or after a block id. Sent as JSON string or object.

schema.label: page_size
schema.description: Page size for block_list, user_list (query) and database_page_list (body). Max 100. Example: 20.

schema.label: user_id
schema.description: User id for user_get. Example: 2b1c3d4e-....

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: page_create, page_archive, page_get, page_update, page_search, database_get, database_page_create, database_page_get, database_page_list, database_page_update, block_append, block_list, block_get, user_get, user_list, data_source_get, data_source_search, listen. Default: page_create. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event. Example: page_create.

configurationParameters.label: Integration Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey integration_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
